mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO report_interpretation_evidence (id, interpretation_id, evidence_id, doc_id, title, snippet, url) VALUES
(#{r.id}, #{r.interpretationId}, #{r.evidenceId}, #{r.docId}, #{r.title}, #{r.snippet}, #{r.url})
mapper.select: SELECT id, interpretation_id AS interpretationId, evidence_id AS evidenceId, doc_id AS docId, title, snippet, url FROM report_interpretation_evidence WHERE interpretation_id = #{interpretationId} ORDER BY evidence_id
